numerical_contract.epilogue: optional FP32 bias[n] followed by ReLU; no intermediate rounding beyond FP32 C
numerical_contract.exceptional_values: inputs and bias finite; no NaN/Inf; generated range avoids overflow and subnormal inputs
numerical_contract.reference_output: immutable per-case binary64 C and sum_abs_products generated from represented_inputs on CPU before any device run
numerical_contract.represented_inputs: serialized IEEE binary16 bit patterns; all routes consume these exact bits
numerical_contract.tolerance_interpretation: gamma-scaled thresholds are a predeclared per-output FP32 admission policy checked against every output; they are not a universal proved hardware error bound because PTX MMA accumulation order and rounding are unspecified

reference_output.format: KWVREF01: little-endian dimensions/seed, row-major FP64 C, row-major FP64 sum_abs_products
